description: Set organization-wide defaults, any combination in one call: defaultHomeLocationId (where new items live by default; a location resource id), defaultResponsiblePersonId (who is responsible for every item that names nobody; a PERSON resource id), defaultLanguage (en/de/fr/es/it: emails and new members), defaultCurrency (ISO 4217 code such as EUR: the currency a NEW currency field gets when none is named; existing fields keep theirs), orderDefaultAssigneeUserId and ticketDefaultAssignees (who handles incoming orders / tickets of a type by default; userIds from list_members; the target must already be responsible for orders/tickets there, see responsibleForOrders/responsibleForTickets). Admin only. Idempotent.

defaultCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code (e.g. CHF, EUR, GBP, USD) that a new currency field gets when it is created without currencyCode. Changing it never touches existing fields or their values

defaultHomeLocationId.description: Location resource id new items default to

defaultResponsiblePersonId.description: Person resource id (from search_resources) who is responsible for every item that names nobody — the last link of the chain blueprint > category > organization. The person must have a member account in this organization. It can be repointed but never cleared: the organization always has one

orderDefaultAssigneeUserId.description: userId (from list_members) who handles incoming orders by default

name: set_org_defaults

updated.description: Which defaults were written (empty when no argument was passed)

title: Set organization defaults
